credentials: Dedicated solely to commercial landscape maintenance

services.title: Landscape Maintenance
services.short_description: Scheduled mowing, edging, weeding and turf care that keeps a commercial property presentable every week of the year.
services.long_description: Maintenance is the core of what GreenTree does. Crews run a fixed schedule so grounds staff and property managers know exactly when the site is serviced, and the work is documented so nothing quietly slips. Lawn mowing, edging, weeding of beds and hardscape joints, and Integrated Pest Management are all handled under one contract by one crew that knows the property.

services.title: Pruning
services.short_description: Hedge, shrub and ornamental pruning on a cycle that keeps sightlines clear and plantings healthy.
services.long_description: Pruning on a commercial site is as much about liability and appearance as it is about plant health — blocked signage, overgrown walkways and hedges pushing into parking stalls are the complaints property managers hear first. GreenTree prunes on a cycle rather than on demand, cutting to the plant's growth habit so the shape holds between visits instead of forcing a hard cutback later.

services.title: Irrigation
services.short_description: Irrigation system inspections that catch broken heads, misaimed spray and wasted water before they show up on the lawn or the bill.
services.long_description: In South Florida an irrigation fault does not stay hidden for long — dry patches, washed-out beds and runoff across a parking lot all trace back to the same handful of causes. GreenTree inspects zones on a schedule, checks head coverage and arc, and reports what needs repair rather than letting a failing system quietly kill the turf that the maintenance contract is meant to protect.

services.title: Planting
services.short_description: Plant and seasonal colour installation that refreshes entrances, medians and common areas without disrupting the property.
services.long_description: Planting is where a commercial property gets its character back. Whether it is refreshing the colour at a building entrance, replacing plant material that has aged out, or filling in beds after a storm, GreenTree installs to the site's light, drainage and salt exposure rather than to a catalogue — because the plant that survives the first summer is the one that was chosen for the spot.
